alternateRoutesUsingScannerSilence.description: the non-semantic classification branch (page furniture, citation, quoted label, numbered caption, structural noise) is entered only when the scanner found nothing. Inside it the canary #6/#9/#11/RT-3 guards (digits, non-Latin letters, adjuncts, operators) protect the STRUCTURAL_NOISE sink, and the caption rule is protected by isNominalLabel - but isNominalLabel does not reject a label carrying digits, so the original p3 date '31 March 2030' is accepted as caption '31' + name 'March 2030'. This is the one route found where scanner silence is a necessary condition for an accounted disposition on a substantive original probe. Recorded as the matrix BLOCKER row; not fixed.
